findings.current: The glaring white flash that had made everyone shield their eyes faded.
findings.defect: The draft makes everyone shield their eyes; the source says the flash obscured their vision.
findings.rationale: The flash covers what they can see; no one is described raising a hand or otherwise shielding their eyes.
findings.replacement: The blinding white flash that had obscured everyone’s vision faded.
findings.source: 모두가 눈 앞을 가렸던 새하얀 섬광이 사라진 빈자리를

findings.current: the woman called the Grand Mage—or the Grand Sorceress—
findings.defect: Grand Sorceress conflicts with the supplied glossary, which renders both titles as Grand Mage.
findings.rationale: Both 대마도사 and 대술사 have the binding English rendering Grand Mage.
findings.replacement: the woman known as the Grand Mage

findings.current: The woman called the Grand Mage—or the Grand Sorceress—silently gazed at the hellscape spread out below the hill.
findings.defect: The later occurrence repeats the non-glossary title Grand Sorceress.
findings.rationale: The supplied glossary renders both Korean titles as Grand Mage; this is a separate, nonoverlapping draft occurrence.
findings.replacement: The Grand Mage silently gazed at the hellscape spread out below the hill.
findings.source: 대마도사, 혹은 대술사라 불리는 그녀는 언덕 아래에 펼쳐진 불지옥을 말없이 바라보았다.

summary: One altered physical action and two uses of a title that conflicts with the supplied glossary.
